source_text: Ingens multitudo adversum Israel; Dominus: Multus est populus tecum; non tradam Madian — ne glorietur Israel. Qui non oderit patrem — militia Christi abrenuntiat.
pass_a_gloss: Huge multitude against Israel; Lord: Much is people with-you; not I-will-hand Midian — lest boast Israel. Who not has-hated father — militia of-Christ renounces.
pass_b_english: A huge host against Israel; the Lord: [[The people with you are too many; I will not give Midian into their hand, lest Israel boast >> Bible:Judges 7:2]]. [[Whoever does not hate father and mother >> Bible:Luke 14:26]] — Christ’s militia renounces.
notes: True OET; no copyrighted Judges FOTC.
